method: Primary papers, official software documentation and original authors' repositories; tables/sections cross-checked manually

references.title: YOLOv13: Real-Time Object Detection with Hypergraph-Enhanced Adaptive Visual Perception
references.verification: Full text and official iMoonLab/yolov13 repository agree on own N/S benchmark rows.

references.title: YOLOv12: Attention-Centric Real-Time Object Detectors
references.publication_type: arXiv v1; subsequent NeurIPS 2025 conference version differs
references.verification: Pin v1 metrics; do not mix with current Turbo or conference tables.

references.title: Ultralytics YOLO11
references.publication_type: official software documentation; no formal official research paper
references.verification: Official page explicitly states no formal research paper for YOLO11; citation is software, not a peer-reviewed architecture article.

references.title: YOLOv10: Real-Time End-to-End Object Detection
references.publication_type: NeurIPS 2024; metrics pinned to arXiv v1 and official repository
references.verification: Main latency column is end-to-end; separate Latency-f column is forward-only. Use main column.

references.title: DETRs Beat YOLOs on Real-time Object Detection
anchors: Official repository model table: COCO rows only
references.verification: Do not substitute COCO+Objects365 rows for COCO-only variants.

references.title: RT-DETRv2: Improved Baseline with Bag-of-Freebies for Real-Time Detection Transformer
references.verification: v1 S has 47.9 AP; current official repository improved S has 48.1, stored separately in version notes.

references.title: BadPatch: Diffusion-Based Generation of Physical Adversarial Patches
references.publication_type: arXiv v5; ICCV 2025 Findings workshop listing
references.verification: Latest arXiv title/three authors supersede old DiffPatch/seven-author citation in dataset README. CVF workshop listing was found, but direct full-text opening failed; use verified arXiv full text.

references.title: Adversarial T-shirt! Evading Person Detectors in A Physical World
references.verification: Physical/digital attack success is a distinct endpoint from detector COCO AP.

version_discrepancies.note: Current Turbo N: AP40.4, params2.5M, FLOPs6.0G, latency1.60ms. Original v1 N40.6/2.6M/6.5G/1.64ms. Do not silently substitute updated release for locally used weights.
Authors reran official YOLO11 and YOLOv12 v1 on same training hardware; N AP38.6/40.1, S45.8/47.1. Hence reported YOLO13 gains refer to these reruns, not official docs or original paper figures.
Current repo S AP48.1/AP50 65.1 vs arXivv1 47.9/64.9.

published_architecture_ablations.ownership: Original authors' published ablations; not local experiments

fullpad_hyperace.note: No tunnels equals removing effective HyperACE according to authors; not independent isolated HyperACE/FullPAD factorial ablation

ds_blocks.note: Parameter/FLOPs benefit at equal rounded AP in this published ablation; does not guarantee faster local PyTorch latency

unreported_values_policy: Use null; do not guess missing batch, timing boundary, dtype or repetitions.
retrieval_failures: Direct opening of CVF BadPatch workshop PDF/HTML returned Internal Error; verified arXiv v5 full text used instead.
